conviction_note: Near non-result: the Q3 bar (~$1.31 core EPS) sits inside the run-rate implied by the company's own H2 guide (NIM 4.25-4.35%, opex $94-98m, nonII $18-22m), the only fresh external read is a non-overlapping peer (FB Financial, 2026-10-13) showing Q3 deposit-cost pressure that EQBK already guided into, and this name barely reacts to beats (Q2 core $1.41 vs ~$1.25 bar bought +0.47%); abs_move 2.3 from the 1.76% median plus a possible first Q4/Lincoln-inclusive outlook after the 2026-09-16 Fed hike, p_up 48 for the small funding-cost lean, so (2*0.48-1)*2.3 = -0.09 against an impact_sum of -0.20.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS $1.31 (Benzinga, revenue $85.0M, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/EQBK/earnings-forecasts) and $1.32 (Earnings Whispers, https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/x/EQBK) - two agreeing sources; TickFlow's Aug-1 average $1.27 (3 analysts, range $1.23-1.31, https://tickflow.io/stock/EQBK/forecast) is older. Cross-check against the company's H2 guide in the Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001227500/000119312526303176/eqbk-ex99_1.htm): NIM 4.25-4.35%, nonII $18-22m, opex $94-98m for H2, which on ~$6.8-6.9bn earning assets and ~20.6m diluted shares gives roughly $1.25-1.37 core EPS, so the bar is inside the guided range. Whether consensus is core or GAAP is not stated by either source; GAAP will carry Lincoln merger costs.
positioning_check: Short interest 467,632 shares, days to cover 3.80, settlement 2026-03-13 (https://equibles.com/stocks/eqbk/shortinterest); MarketBeat 2025-09-30 settlement 268,700 shares, 2.9 days (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/EQBK/short-interest). Roughly 2-2.5% of float, not crowded; no October 2026 figure found. Option chain unusable (ATM spread 186% of mid, total OI 288), so no skew; put/call OI 0.06 on 288 contracts carries no information. Tape: -5.55% over 20 sessions, -10.15% from the 52-week high, down from $49.85 on 2026-09-02 (deal-announcement reference price) to $46.48.

findings.finding: A bank peer that reported Q3 2026 after EQBK last spoke (FB Financial, 2026-10-13) showed total deposit cost up 6bp to 2.32% and NIM down 12bp to 3.83% on 'increased pricing on interest-bearing deposits', in a quarter in which the FOMC raised rates 25bp on 2026-09-16 after three July dissents for a hike; that points to the low half of EQBK's 4.25-4.35% NIM guide rather than the 'optimism toward the higher end' management voiced in July.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EQBK's NIM moved 4.33% to 4.36% in Q2 2026 with a core beat and the stock rose +0.47% (baseline, 2026-07-14); the largest reaction in the 7-print history is -6.63% (2025-07-14), and no NIM-specific miss is isolated in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $1.31-1.32 has not moved toward a lower-NIM run-rate as far as the sources show (TickFlow's August average was $1.27 and the later figures are higher, not lower); if a funding-cost squeeze were priced, estimates would have been trimmed after the September hike and the peer print. But EQBK already guided NIM down from 4.36% and the stock is -5.55% over 20 days, so part of it is likely in the price, which is why it is small.
findings.independence: Proxy: a Tennessee bank, not a direct EQBK counterparty. The Fed statement of 2026-09-16 (https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260916a.htm), a hike to 3.75-4.00%, is the independent macro series pointing the same way on funding cost; it lands only in the last two weeks of Q3. A hike can lift EQBK's high-yield loan book as well, and the company's rate sensitivity table (10-Q) could not be read (file too large to fetch).

findings.finding: EQBK's Q2 2026 core EPS was $1.41 (GAAP $1.27) on NIM 4.36%, core nonII $10.3m, opex ex-merger $46.8m and a $1.3m provision, against a Q3 bar of $1.31-1.32; with the company's own H2 guide the Q3 run-rate is about $1.25-1.37, so the bar is inside guidance and a modest core beat is slightly more likely than a miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: core $1.41 against a bar around $1.23-1.27 (a beat of roughly 10%) bought only +0.47% (baseline 2026-07-14); 2026-04-14 -2.52%, 2026-01-21 -0.20%. This name does not pay much for beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar sits below the last quarter's core run-rate. If the market expected a repeat of $1.41, consensus would sit near $1.38-1.40 rather than $1.31. But the result lands inside what the company guided to, and the stock barely reacted to a larger beat last quarter, so the finding is held near zero.
findings.independence: Pipeline commentary from the same Q2 call ($1.6bn pipeline, +23% QoQ; low- to mid-single-digit H2 loan growth; https://stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/EQBK/2026/Q2) points the same way but comes from the same event; the dividend raise from $0.18 to $0.22 declared 2026-09-10 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1227500/000119312526390696/eqbk-20260910.htm) is a separate board-level signal of earnings confidence, and it is public.

findings.finding: The Lincoln Bancorp S-4 (filed 2026-10-05) shows Federal Reserve and Kansas OSBC applications submitted but no approval yet, a Q4 2026 close targeted, Lincoln credit costs estimated at about zero with a price-reduction clause above $15.2m of merger costs, and a $27.8m pro forma loan mark; the Q3 release will carry first Lincoln merger expenses in GAAP and likely the first Lincoln-inclusive outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print isolates a deal update; the stock fell from $49.85 (2026-09-02, deal reference price) to $46.48 (2026-10-14) through the announcement period, so dilution concern was likely expressed before this print.
findings.why_not_priced: Deal terms (5.1% 2027 EPS accretion, TBV earnback under 3 years) are already on the wire. What is not known is whether approval arrives with the release, and how merger costs and the closing outlook are presented. The sign is genuinely open, so the finding is sized at 0 with a symmetric band.
findings.independence: 8-K of 2026-09-03 deal announcement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001227500/000119312526381051/d152469dex991.htm), same deal, same issuer; it does not add an independent sign.

outside_window.finding: Lincoln Bancorp merger close and regulatory approvals, expected Q4 2026 per the S-4; outside date 2027-06-30. Approval timing is undated and most likely after the exit window.
